title: Winning Battles in the Mind Through Faith
description: This powerful sermon from Pastor Chris Zehner shares a remarkable testimony of victory over spiritual attack and the importance of standing firm in faith, even when our bodies are weak. Join Pastor Chris as he recounts a harrowing experience of being poisoned, hospitalized, and even sent to the ICU, but ultimately emerging with a powerful message of God's life-giving power. Don't miss this inspiring account of God's faithfulness and the lessons learned through Pastor Chris's journey.
